quote: Show the scope. Then show the evidence. Leave time for the question.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use THREE MINUTE STORY in Avenir with six small scene bars and a separate 03:00 descriptor. The timing is an application label, not part of every logo lockup.
invariants: Use Avenir headings on warm paper with a restrained amber timing cue.
Make the planned total duration prominent without implying a measured rehearsal.

adaptations: A rehearsal sheet may show all six scenes together.
A presentation version shows one scene at a time and keeps fallback notes separate.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
